1429-3899-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-3899-5958.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

710-728-7424.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4559-5147-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4094-4559-5147-7839.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2

792-1580-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

647-1409-3099-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6154.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing White Plume Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-5223-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-5223-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

6798-7084-7422.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

141-2292-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2292-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-4885-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-4885-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

11-2631-6555-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2631-6555-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Alrund's Epiphany.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alrund's Epiphany and returning the original Alrund's Epiphany to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alrund's Epiphany from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

5147-5220-6539-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

640-1894-2173-5220.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

856-5256-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

955-1563-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1089-1339-6466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1089-1339-6466.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Shocking Sharpshooter, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-6273.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
2034-3097-3490-6273.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

101-1987-4276-4823.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-4276-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Timeless Witness and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-4276-4823.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1458-5864--63.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1458-5864--63.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Banishing Knack.
Cast the noncreature permanent by paying {0}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning the noncreature permanent cast in step 4 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

3388-5756.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying {2}{G}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Moritte of the Frost triggers from step 3, returning all legendary creature card(s) with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

3388-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, milling target player a number of cards equal to Morrite of the Frost's power.
Repeat.

4067-4317-4613-5680.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it that has the creature type chosen with Kindred Boon.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
4067-4317-4613-5680.description:
Activate Kindred Boon by paying {1}{W}, putting a divinity counter on any creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate that creature using Myojin of Seeing Winds's ability by removing a divinity counter from it, causing you to draw a card for each permanent you control.
Activate two mana-producing permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping the mana-producing permanents.
Repeat.

915-1283-5295.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Thousand-Year Elixir and Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2732-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact token.
2732-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact token, adding {C}{C}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of River Kelpie

2034-3607-3908.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spark Double, adding {C}{C}.
When Spark Double dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
As Spark Double enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it and River Kelpie's first abilities trigger.
Resolve both triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

1171-3499-4499.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, exiling and returning Garth One-Eye onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1810-2034-2634-4783.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, targeting Cackling Counterpart.
Choose to have Rootha returned to the command zone instead of your hand.
Resolve the Rootha ability, copying Cackling Counterpart, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Resolve the copy of Cackling Counterpart, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser.
Hellkite Courser enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1528-2940-5195.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1528-2940-5195.description:
Cast Triton Tactics by paying {U}, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Triton Tactics targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
 Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Triton Tactics, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and giving it +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1912-4257-4499-4826.description:
Activate Emiel, exiling Golos and returning Golos to the battlefield.
Golos triggers, searching your library for a land and putting it onto the battlefield untapped.
Repeat.

738-1202-3370-4659.description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Moonvessel and Butcher of Malakir trigger.
Resolve Myr Moonvessel's trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve Butcher of Malakir's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Myr Moonvessel to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {1}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
